UPDATE tournaments
               SET status = CASE
                       WHEN now() >= starts_at + make_interval(mins => duration_minutes)
                           THEN 'finished'
                       ELSE 'live'
                   END,
                   ended_at = CASE
                       WHEN now() >= starts_at + make_interval(mins => duration_minutes)
                           THEN starts_at + make_interval(mins => duration_minutes)
                       ELSE NULL
                   END
               WHERE format = 'arena'
                 AND status IN ('upcoming', 'live')
                 AND now() >= starts_at
                 AND (status = 'upcoming'
                      OR now() >= starts_at + make_interval(mins => duration_minutes))
